name: oil-pump
description: An oil pumpjack with a curved horsehead, walking beam and a connected crank drive.
useCase: Identify an oil pumpjack in an industrial facility or energy infrastructure map.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The rear drive connects the walking beam to a crank on the base. The front rod starts at the head's outer edge.

24.reason: The connected crank drive stays clear of the support frame, and the front rod meets the curved head without protruding into it.
